name: 日本の国民の祝日・銀行休業日 (1949–2030)
title: 日本の国民の祝日・銀行休業日 (1949–2030)
description: Japanese national public holidays (国民の祝日) and bank holidays (銀行休業日) for 1949–2030 with multilingual names (ja/en/th), computed algorithmically by vacanza/holidays per the Public Holiday Law (祝日法, Law No. 178 of 1948) and subsequent amendments. Covers all major reforms: Happy Monday system (2000), Mountain Day addition (2016), Sports Day rename (2020), Emperor Reiwa accession-era 10-day Golden Week (2019), and substitute holidays (振替休日) when a public holiday falls on Sunday.
